method: Actual view_image inspection of all 18 existing complete-duration 2fps contact sheets, plus 9 standalone idle/seated/end room screenshots. Source videos were SHA256-read for linkage.

viewedImages.observation: Loading/view setup followed by room idle and initial movement. Head, torso and clothing silhouette are present at visible sampled instants.
Outbound/return locomotion and turns. No large torso opening, detached limb or gross clothing penetration identified at room-view scale in these sampled instants.
Approach to chair, sit, seated pause and rise. Visible torso remains clothed. Arms and chair obscure portions of waist, hips and seat contact.
Rise completion/return locomotion and transition toward technical dance. No anatomically disconnected posture or large missing clothing region identified in sampled instants.
Technical dance sampled poses retain connected head/body/limbs and clothing silhouette. Half-second sampling cannot establish transition quality.
Dance ending/idle tail. Back/side torso silhouette remains present. Fine seam and contact details remain unresolved at room-view scale.
Head, dark top, shorts/pants and boots are present. No large opening identified in visible front/side silhouette.

Seated head/torso/legs remain connected and visible. Hands overlap the lower torso/thigh region and chair overlaps hip/seat boundaries. Small light pixels near the hem cannot be attributed from this view.
Back/side idle silhouette is present. Fine dotted diagnostic marks are visible near the forearm and are not attributed to a surface defect by this review.

observations.headBody: No gross head/body detachment, inversion or limb discontinuity identified at sampled instants.
observations.clothing: No large missing torso region or large exposed inner layer identified at room-view scale in sampled instants. Fine waist specks and exact hem coverage remain unresolved.
observations.locomotionSitRise: Sampled poses show locomotion, chair approach, seated pause, rise and return locomotion without a gross sampled posture failure. Chair and arms hide some contact regions.
observations.poseTransitions: No sampled pose discontinuity can be confirmed. Continuity, foot sliding and naturalness require full-speed playback review.

limits: Half-second sampling can omit transient penetration, a pop or a single-frame pose failure. Contact sheets cannot establish continuous normal-speed naturalness.
Characters occupy a small portion of each room-view tile. A lack of visible large defects does not establish absence of millimeter-scale green/light exposure or exact triangle contact.
Hands/arms, chair and body orientation occlude waist/seat/back surfaces during parts of the sequence. These hidden surfaces remain unassessed in those frames.
Contact sheet initial loading and camera setup differ across cases. The timelines are capture-relative and are not frame-aligned pose comparisons.
Close waist views and full-speed continuous review are handled separately by root. Historical unexplained edge pixel [482,454] remains unresolved by this room-scale review.
The before-ed2 room material was not used for a frame-matched visual comparison in this bounded review. No before/after improvement claim is made.
